title: Verify bounded EUR ability mastery effect
changes: Record one bounded CH-0320 ability mastery effect in the advanced cheat group without claiming verification of every ability or character.
validation: In an isolated EUR Party scene, Marsh Steal: Ability displayed 180 before one armed interpreter frame and MASTER! after disarm and reopening the list; the same-seed/input/frame no-cheat control remained at 180. Pre-cheat state, frame and clock matched. Both exact seeds were restored, sessions and displays closed, and protected originals and pins stayed unchanged.

The enabled list expanded, so the final selected rows differed while the same ability remained visible. A first interactive run closed on EOF before gameplay; a later graphics request hit the report cap after inputs and the paused GUI was captured instead.
limitations: This covers one ability and Party scene under Wine/interpreter; all abilities and characters, other side effects, native Windows, physical input and original device-hook equivalence remain unverified. Disarm itself did not restore state.
